title: Napoleon’s Malta
description: Liam Gauci, curator at Malta’s maritime museum, on 1798, when Napoleon took Malta from the knights on his way to Egypt, and the Maltese revolt that followed. Napoleon spent six days in Palazzo Parisio on Merchants Street.
